project.name: Aurora — The Living Signal
project.objective: Turn Aurora into a trustworthy, cinematic global media house whose live-status, discovery, playback, and AI capabilities are immediately legible.
project.audience: General-audience viewers exploring film, music, public live television, and radio on desktop and mobile.
project.governing_idea: One amber-cyan signal travels through a believable near-future media world and changes form with each medium.

creative_system.visual_thesis: A single motivated transmission line reveals tactile architecture, real adult users, and the working state of the product.

palette.contrast: matte dark architecture with precise warm human light and a restrained cyan transmission edge

creative_system.composition: One primary subject group on the right third, readable layered depth, and calm left-side negative space for editable web copy.
creative_system.camera: Stable 35 mm perspective with a restrained, physically coherent orbit that returns to its opening frame.
creative_system.lighting: Warm motivated practical key light, cyan edge light, deep ink shadows, and controlled coral reflections.
creative_system.typography: All product copy remains editable HTML with high contrast and no text generated inside scene media.
creative_system.motion: The signal completes one purposeful pulse cycle; camera and subjects return to the first-frame state for a seamless loop.
creative_system.sound: Strategic silence: every web loop is delivered without generated audio.
creative_system.interface: Responsive, keyboard accessible, touch-safe, and equivalent under reduced-motion and data-saver preferences.
invariants: Keep the amber-cyan signal motif, material palette, right-third adult composition, stable horizon, and negative-space convention consistent.
Use fictional adults only, with no logos, copyrighted screens, alcohol, smoking, weapons, sexual content, or dangerous activity.
Use motion to explain transmission and state rather than decorate the interface.
permitted_variations: Adapt the signal into a film strip, waveform, world arc, tuner band, or intent path by route.
Adapt framing to desktop and mobile while preserving subject identity and readable negative space.

scenes.title: The Living Signal
scenes.summary: A single signal cycles through cinema, music, broadcast, and radio environments while adults experience the media house.

shots.purpose: Create the home-page cinematic master and establish the visual law for every route.
shots.action: The signal travels through floor channels, rises into a glass sphere, and unfolds into four original abstract media environments before returning to its opening position.
shots.composition: Fictional adults on the right third with dark, uncluttered left-side copy space.
shots.camera: One slow clockwise micro-orbit with subtle forward drift, returning precisely to the starting framing.
shots.lighting: Deep ink shadows, warm amber skin key, cyan edge light, and restrained coral reflections.
shots.motion: One complete signal pulse; minimal breathing and head movement; matching first and final frames.
shots.vfx: Physically integrated signal channels, abstract picture planes, restrained haze, and subtle material reflections.
continuity: Preserve adult identities, wheelchair geometry, wardrobe, environment geometry, signal path, horizon, and light direction.
First and final frames must match for a seamless loop.
exclusions: text, captions, numbers, logos, brands, or watermarks
alcohol, smoking, weapons, violence, sexual content, or dangerous activity
identity drift, extra limbs, face drift, flicker, geometry morphing, abrupt movement, or camera shake

rights_and_claims.description: The uploaded keyframe is original AI-generated project artwork with fictional adults and no third-party logos or copyrighted screens.
Only public or official external streams are indexed; Aurora does not host or circumvent access restrictions.

review_notes: The generated scene contains fictional adults only and no readable brands, logos, copyrighted screens, alcohol, smoking, weapons, violence, sexual content, or unsafe activity.
The model output did not return precisely to its opening composition; the web master was finished as a forward/reverse loop so the delivery seam is exact.
The web master is silent H.264, 1920x1080, 24 fps, 10 seconds, and approximately 3.2 MB.

assumptions: The first redesign's local Aurora imagery remains approved visual source material.
The master is silent and decorative; all meaning remains available in editable interface copy.
The 262-credit supporting batch will not run without a separate reviewed execution decision.
open_questions: Whether to execute the six supporting route loops after the hero master is reviewed.
risks: Volatile third-party stream origins require freshness scoring and official-site fallbacks.
Autoplay video can affect data usage; use poster fallback under Save-Data and reduced motion.
AI video can drift despite matched references; reject and regenerate rather than masking a continuity failure.
